text_block_list.text: While taking a breather from work on the rooftop...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However... there is no need to worry.
It is only a slight throbbing, not enough to hinder my daily life—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh—... A-Also...
Just a moment ago, I took some headache medicine... with water. Gulp, gulp.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: After that... I'll recover... while... taking... class... in the classroom...

It seems she has a headache so severe that medication isn't working.
I'd better figure out how to deal with this...
